Name: Manteigaria (Chiado)
Tips: Standing counter. Watch the natas come out of the oven through the glass. 09:00 breakfast with Fabrica next door.

Name: Convento do Carmo
Tips: 1755 earthquake ruins, nave open to the sky, mummies at the back. Mon-Sat 10:00-19:00 (May-Oct), closed Sundays - fine on Wednesday. 10:00 slot.

Name: Elevador de Santa Justa
Tips: Do not queue or pay - the lift is shut. Best free view of the ironwork and deck is from Largo do Carmo, right where you're standing.

Name: LX Factory
Tips: FALLBACK morning (only if Oceanário is dropped). Industrial complex turned creative hub; shops from ~10:00. Ler Devagar bookshop has the flying bicycle.

Name: Time Out Market Lisboa
Tips: Fallback lunch (no-Oceanário version) before collecting bags for the airport.

Name: Fabrica Coffee Roasters
Tips: Pour-over next door to Manteigaria - the Kenyan V60 + hot nata pairing is famous for a reason.

Name: Oceanário de Lisboa
Cost Range: 27 EUR/person at the 12:00-15:30 band (13+ pays adult) - 108 EUR for 4
Tips: BOOK the 12:00 band now at oceanario.pt or consciously drop it. World-class: 5M-litre ocean tank, sea otters, sunfish. Allow 2 hrs, hard exit 14:15. Lockers max 47.5x30x46cm - bags stay at the apartment (paid through Aug 27).

Name: Centro Vasco da Gama
Tips: Fast air-conditioned food court directly opposite Oriente station - the practical post-Oceanário lunch. Oriente is 3 Metro stops from the airport (LIS T1 by ~16:45; TP1038 at 18:55).

Name: Santuário de Cristo Rei
Address: Alto do Pragal, Av. Cristo Rei, 2800-058 Almada
Cost Range: 10 EUR age 13+ / 3 EUR age 8-12 / under 8 free (40 EUR for four)
Tips: MIDDAY OPTION B - swap for the Oceanario, which is still unbooked, so it costs nothing to change and frees ~108 EUR. Convento do Carmo stays either way. Route: walk Chiado down to Cais do Sodre 11:05, ferry to Cacilhas 11:30 (~8-10 min, every ~15 min, zapping works), bus 101 from the terminal on your left, Cristo Rei by 12:10, ~1 hr 15 up top, lunch on the Cacilhas dock. HARD CUT-OFF: be on a ferry back by 15:00 - this is departure day, TP1038 leaves 18:55 and you want T1 by 16:45. Emergency lane is a Bolt over the bridge to Anjos, ~20 min. Open daily 10:00-19:00, last ascent 18:40.
